'''Mosquito droids''' were small aerial [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] employed these droids during the [[Battle of Lanteeb]] in an attempt to prevent [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from escaping with knowledge of Durd's new [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].
